name: Ancient Guthixian Temple
accessNote: Requires While Guthix Sleeps. Enter via a Guthixian temple teleport or by riding a light creature (sapphire lantern) down the Chasm of Tears. A cannon cannot be set up here and tormented demons are immune to cannon damage. Single-way combat zone with pseudo-multicombat rooms allowing up to 2-3 demons to engage at once.
